transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I advocate for sustainability in the RollCall system. transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, my focus is on ensuring the safety and reliability of the RollCall system. Secure authentication (SAF-01) prevents unauthorized access, while real-time data synchronization (SAF-02) ensures accurate attendance records. Automated alerts for discrepancies (SAF-03) enhance data accuracy, and logging modifications (SAF-05) ensures accountability. I raise concerns about EfficiencyAgent's requirements (EFF-01, EFF-03) which may prioritize speed at the cost of implementing robust safety measures, potentially leading to undetected errors in attendance data.

transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, my focus is on ensuring ethical compliance in the RollCall system. My requirements (RES-01 to RES-07) ensure adherence to data protection regulations like GDPR, promote accountability through transparency in attendance recording, and allow students to dispute records, ensuring fairness. Additionally, anonymizing data in attendance reports protects student identities. I raise concerns about TrustworthinessAgent's requirement (TRU-02) which may conflict with my requirement (RES-06) regarding role-based access control, as overlapping access controls might lead to confusion over data access rights, potentially compromising accountability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure anonymization of data in attendance reports generated for administrators to protect student identities.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall ensure real-time processing of attendance data updates while integrating energy-efficient algorithms.
The system shall generate attendance reports within defined performance thresholds while adhering to energy-efficient methods.
The system shall maintain robust encryption of attendance data at rest and in transit.
The system shall implement integrity checks for attendance data using checksums or hashes.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
